Can specify multiple formats separated by commas (e.g., htm,sql,sqld,txt,json,xml): csv – Comma-separated-value json – JSON Format htm – HTML Format sql – Generic SQL file of INSERT statements (see documentation/nikto_schema_mysql.sql or nikto_schema_postgresql.sql) sqld – SQL Direct: insert findings into MySQL/PostgreSQL via DBI (see [[SQL Direct Reporting]]; no -output required) txt – Plain text xml – XML Format (if not specified the format will be taken from the file extension passed to -output)
